purpose: End-to-end receipt OCR acceptance fixtures for Settleora, including currency ambiguity, locale formats, common receipt semantics/layouts, and degraded-image regressions.

rules.authoritative_boundary: Assert the final structured preview the user sees, not raw OCR character accuracy.
rules.clean_fixture_policy: Clean synthetic fixtures are strict: every expected field must match.
rules.native_provider_policy: At least one automated lane must invoke the real on-device OCR provider from an image file path; fake providers do not satisfy this gate.
rules.known_gaps_are_not_xfail: Do not mark unsupported languages/currencies as expected failures. A failing global fixture is an implementation gap.
rules.currency_resolution_policy: Currency assertions may include resolution source: explicit, context_inferred, default_fallback, or unresolved. Shared symbols must not be treated as globally unique.
rules.ambiguous_symbol_policy: Bare $, ¥, kr, and Rs require explicit markers, strong receipt context, configured fallback, or unresolved review state in that order.
rules.distortion_policy: Degraded fixtures retain the same core ground truth as their clean source. Merchant/date/currency/total are mandatory unless the source intentionally lacks that field.
